summary: MaintServiceProfile is a web page for managing and viewing service profiles in an enterprise system, supporting multiple panels for general profile, positions, and historical data. It dynamically loads and displays details related to a service (such as agency, site, contact), enforces business rules for editability, and provides validation and feedback mechanisms for user actions.
purpose: To provide a user interface for viewing, editing, and managing service profiles, including their positions and history, with features for conditional editing, error/warning display, and data validation consistent with system access rules.

workflows.name: Page Load
steps: Determine read-only status (from query string and edit rules)
Setup page footer and client scripts
Set active tab based on currentPage or default
Disable Positions tab if SiteUsesPositions is false
Link child controls (UCProfile, UCPositions, UCHistory) depending on active tab

workflows.name: Tab Change/Refresh
steps: Switch active tab to Profile, Positions, or History as specified
Child controls are linked and data-bound based on the active tab, visibility is managed

workflows.name: Error/Warning Handling
steps: Display error or warning panels with captions and lists
Users can hide panels using provided buttons

workflows.name: Validation
steps: Validate pay scale effective date if pay scale codes are selected
Ensure default pay scale code must be selected if a secondary code is

workflows.name: Page PreRender
steps: Register client script for window resize

business_rules: Screen is editable only if not ReadOnly and user is either SystemAdministrator or their agency matches ServiceAgencyID.
Positions tab is enabled only if SiteUsesPositions is true.
Profile and Positions headers display an 'exist' flag if relevant data exists.
Default pay scale must be chosen if secondary pay scale is selected.
validations: Pay scale effective date must be provided if pay scale codes are selected.
Secondary pay scale cannot be selected unless default is selected.
conditions: Page is read-only if ReadOnly query string is '1' or edit rules do not permit.
Tab visibility and control linkage depend on active tab and existence of data.
system_behavior: Loads and binds data to controls based on ServiceID and active tab.
Handles visibility and editability per user permissions and business rules.
dependencies: UserSession for access control and contextual data
Service entity for profile, positions, and history data
Child user controls for modular display and management: UCProfile, UCPositions, UCHistory
exceptions: If ServiceID is invalid or not found, controls may not display data.
If user lacks edit permission, controls are set read-only.
content_gaps: No detailed UI layouts or control properties beyond what is available via field definitions.
No explicit descriptions of error/warning messages or their logic.
Some referenced controls (e.g., UCProfile, UCPositions, UCHistory) are modular and their internal workings are not included.
